notes.title: Open Beta - New Update: Weather Changes
notes.content: [p]Our latest patch brings weather improvements along with a variety of visual, atmospheric and balance updates.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay & Balance[/b][/h3][p align="start"]With this patch, we've introduced several gameplay balance adjustments: reducing the build/destruct range to 1.5 m (down from 3 m), improving door boarding logic, and preventing the diesel-generator gas lid from being stackable under the arm.  [/p][h3][b]Weather[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Up until now, the world could shift between six major moods: Wet Haze, Blizzard, Thunderstorm, Hail, Clear Skies and Overcast. We’ve added more subtle weather variations to keep you guessing what might come next.[/p][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][p]We have also made some tweaks to audio and atmosphere. You can now hear heartbeat signals for dehydration and hunger, tinnitus and gradual world-volume muffling in critical states.[/p][h3][b]UI [/b][/h3][p]The inventory also got a small update this patch: wet items now show a blue background, so they're easier to spot.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45476654/1d7bffe6d9c779b78f5c5b8bb5b6d953e450580b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Patch Notes: 0.20215 [/h2][h3][b]Audio & Atmosphere[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Restored foliage-rustle and rain/hail roof impacts[/p][/*][*][p]Heartbeat now signals dehydration/hunger; intensity scales with risk[/p][/*][*][p]Tinnitus + gradual muffling during critical states [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Visual & UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Wet items show blue background in inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Compass shows on map when in any quick-slot[/p][/*][*][p]Skylight intensity now separates day/night; clearer dusk lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Anti-aliasing toggle added to Settings [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gameplay & Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Diesel-generator gas lid no longer stackable under-arm[/p][/*][*][p]Build/destruct range cut to 1.5m (was 3m)[/p][/*][*][p]Door boarding improved: doors are locked when you board a door to a wall with a plank[/p][/*][*][p]Cooking items update calories in real time again[/p][/*][*][p]Medium landing roll slowed 50%; smoother get-up blends[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Items & Inventory[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Bed, oil-lamp, flashlight, walkman, radio collision fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Paper no longer crumples on inspect; lamp glass lights only when on[/p][/*][*][p]Wetness recalculates when moved in hotbar[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Performance & Systems[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reflections switched to screen-space; minor light tuning[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for invisible items spawning in shelters[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]World & Environment[/b][/h3][list][*][p]LOD fixes on coat-hanger; outhouse-door collision updated[/p][/*][*][p]Removed floating lamp in cabin; added shelf collisions to jetty & shack[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: September 2nd patch notes
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay & Survival[/b]
[list]
[*] Hunger and thirst no longer cause instant death
[*] Poison now has permanent side effects
[*] Fire effects on the player have been reduced
[*] Escape screen has a timer
[/list]

[b]Items & Inventory[/b]
[list]
[*] Added lighter, matchbook, and oil lamps
[*] Inspecting water containers now shows capacity
[*] Inventory tooltips are now context-specific (Eat, Drink, Open, etc.)
[/list]

[b]World & Environment[/b]
[list]
[*] Added audio for rivers
[*] Fixed rocks so players no longer fall through them
[*] Fixed hiking stops having higher temperature than the world
[*] Fixed cabin roofs breaking when first discovered
[*] More randomness in item spawns, cabin durability, and cabin quality outside exploration zones
[/list]

notes.title: July 15th 2025 Playtest
notes.content:
### Interactions 
- Refilling water containers now uses right-click (RMB) instead of E.
- You can now drink from snowy or, if you're brave, muddy ground.
- New input prompts added.
- You can switch on on-screen prompts for item actions.
- The crosshair now animates when you're unable to carry something underarm.
- A circular progress bar appears when holding to interact.

### Mechanics
- Water containers are refillable from snow, but can also store poisonous water.
- Cooking now reduces food size in your inventory — without lowering calories.
- Wild garlic, wild strawberries, and wild carrots now provide better nutrition.

### Inventory 
- Tin cans are now treated separately by type — they no longer stack into the same hand.
- The flashlight correctly shows whether it's on or off inside shelters.
- Waterproof backpacks now protect stored items from rain and help them dry.
- Backpack sizes are now displayed accurately when inspecting them.
- Clothing insulation has a greater effect on your body temperature.
- More clothes can get damaged.

### Environment 
- Added a miniature landscape diorama inside the Weather Tower showing your journey.
- Improved liquid rendering when holding containers.
- Breakable furniture added — cabin tables and chairs can now be destroyed. 
- Map start location and Weather Tower location are now accurately marked.

### Balancing updates
- Balanced items and consumables available from the starting cabin.
- Balanced wetness from swimming, its more dangerous now.
- Rare waterproof and insulated clothing is even rarer now. 
- Balanced getting dry to make it harder. It won't happen until certain conditions are met, e.g. the world temperature is above 2C.
- All shelters now start at the world temperature, its easier to die at the start.
- Fires are harder to maintain in storms, look for rocky outcrops if you are outside.

### Other Bug fixes
